title: Local freeness and lattice compatibility of the explicit continuous encodings
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite-dimensional normed field extension of Q_ell, X any scheme, and P an internal module over its condensed continuous E coefficient ring. Suppose a pro-etale scheme cover trivializes P as finite biproducts of the pulled-back regular module. Its image under the specified rational encoding of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding] is finite locally free as a sectionwise module sheaf. Moreover, for every etale f:Y→X and every specified finite locally free integral sectionwise module M on Y with a specified rationalization isomorphism to the restriction of the encoded P, the actual object inverseEncoding(M) is pro-etale locally finite free as an internal integral module and its ordinary scalar extension is isomorphic to the canonical internal f*P. There is no assertion that M or f exists, no compactness condition, and no finite cover or disjoint-union assembly. The integral and rational coefficient objects and map are those of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients].

proof.text: Apply continuousField_locallyFree to the given raw-inverse-image free cover. For any given finite locally free integral M, apply continuousInteger_inverse_locallyFree to obtain the required pro-etale scheme cover. Both conclusions are proved in the local-freeness comparison, including cover-index universe restriction and coefficient normalization.

Use continuousModuleEncoding_scalar_extension on the specified M to identify the rational encoding of internal extension of inverseEncoding(M) with the actual sheafified sectionwise changeOfRings object. Use continuousField_module_restriction to identify the prescribed etale restriction with the rational encoding of canonical internal inverse image.

Compose the scalar-extension comparison, the supplied rationalization isomorphism, and the inverse restriction comparison. Lift the resulting presheaf isomorphism through the fully faithful forgetful functor for module sheaves and then the fully faithful rational encoding. This is the requested isomorphism between the specified internal modules; no existence of a lattice is asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousModuleEncoding_lattice_compatibility
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj P)) :
    ((continuousFieldModuleEquivalence ℓ E X).functor.obj P).IsFiniteLocallyFree ∧
    ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f]
      (M : ringedSiteModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (lisseIntegerSheaf ℓ E Y))),
      M.IsFiniteLocallyFree →
      Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.changeOfRings (lisseIntegerToField ℓ E Y) M).val ≅
        (PresheafOfModules.pushforward (lisseEtaleCoefficientIdentification ℓ E f)).obj
          ((continuousFieldModuleEquivalence ℓ E X).functor.obj P).val) →
      (∃ D : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage Y, ∀ s : D.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y))
          (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).mapMod _).obj
            ((continuousIntegerModuleEquivalence ℓ E Y).inverse.obj M))) ∧
      Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) Y)).obj
          ((continuousIntegerModuleEquivalence ℓ E Y).inverse.obj M) ≅
        (upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) f).obj P)
